regime_context: The TSX thematic detector as of 2026-08-07 shows Base Metals & Copper as the clear momentum leader, with full breadth, moderate durability (0.7), and no crowding. Gold Miners and Big Banks follow, both with robust trend health. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market, but the ranks carry no forward return edge (rank-IC ~0). The note reflects conditioning on those risk signals only, not return forecasts.
emerging_watch: Watch for Gold Miners to overtake Base Metals as leader: if the rank margin narrows below 0.2 and Gold Miners maintains durability >0.7 and breadth >0.8, consider a handoff confirmed; retire watch if Base Metals margin expands above 0.6.
